name: WVE-N531
sort_evidence: WVE-N531 is Wave's exon 53 oligonucleotide, a different molecule from Sarepta's Vyondys 53 (golodirsen); Wave intends to file an NDA in 2026, and NCT07209332 is enrolling (https://ir.wavelifesciences.com/news-releases/news-release-details/wave-life-sciences-announces-positive-data-forward-53-clinical).
